title: GC Release Manifest
description: Machine-readable pinning contract for a Governance Commons release milestone. Declares the minimum compatible version of each included spec. Adopters who need a stable multi-spec combination pin to a GC release. A manifest advances from 'planned' to 'ready' only after all pinned_version fields are set, all spec versions are published, and compat_hold_items is empty. Defined in PASS-5 (GC-5-F-01).

gc_schema_version.description: Version of this release manifest schema.

release_id.description: Stable identifier for this GC release milestone.

gc_version.description: Semantic version of this GC release.

declared_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when this manifest was first declared.

declared_by.description: GitHub handle or identity of the maintainer who declared this release.

status.description: planned: specs identified, not all versions published yet. ready: all spec versions published, compat matrix clean, no compat-hold items — adopters may pin to this release. deprecated: superseded by a newer release. When status is 'ready', every spec entry MUST have pinned_version set and compat_hold_items MUST be empty.

specs.description: Spec version pins included in this release. Each entry declares the minimum compatible version for one spec. All listed specs are required for release.

spec.description: Canonical spec name matching the name field in projects.yaml.

repo.description: GitHub org/repo path for this spec.

min_version.description: Minimum compatible semver for this spec in the release.

pinned_version.description: Exact published version included in the release. MUST be set when manifest status is 'ready'. Omit when status is 'planned'.

compat_status.description: ok: no open compatibility issues. compat-hold: a breaking change has been declared that blocks this release.

notes.description: Optional notes about this spec pin.

compat_hold_items.description: Open compat-hold items blocking this release from advancing to 'ready'. MUST be empty when status is 'ready'.

gc_pass_id.description: GC-PASS identifier of the gate review that declared or last updated this manifest.

release_notes_ref.description: Path or URL to the release notes for this GC release.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this release manifest.

then.description: When status is 'ready', compat_hold_items MUST be empty.
